title: Gigabud Creates Android Work Profiles to Hide From Banking App Malware Checks
summary: The Gigabud banking trojan now installs a second Android app that creates a work profile on an infected phone and drops a tampered banking app inside it, security firm Group-IB said in a report published on September 9.

A work profile is a separate space that Android typically reserves for employer apps, and what's inside it is kept separate from everything in the personal space.
